text:
Priya Nair: quick heads-up — I'm seeing ~1.2k GPU-hour gap in the May Dedicated allocations vs. committed reservations. Need an owner to reconcile and decide whether to bump next wave or reassign slots. cc @Alex Chen @Nate (eng-infra)
Alex Chen: I'll take a look. which reservation IDs are we comparing?
Priya Nair: comparing commit-sheet v7 (internal link) vs. infra ledger. example missing slot: R-2026-0456. most gaps show on dc-west-2 clusters.
Alex Chen: ok running a quick query
Alex Chen: ```
# rcli reservations query --project dedicated-ramp --start 2026-05-01 --end 2026-05-31 --format json | jq '.[] | select(.status=="committed")'
```
Samira Patel: staging clusters show 90% of canaries green; power audits done. but we have 6 nodes with outdated cuda drivers blocking qemu image bake.
Jorge Ortega: procurement update — H100 batch ship ETA 2026-04-28 for 80 units, customs could add 3-5 days. part numbers look okay.
Kaya Liu: if we delay some reservations can we shift canary traffic to eu-east? latency ok for internal tests.
Nate (eng-infra): eu-east has spare rack PDUs but network bandwidth is burst-limited until we finish the vRack config next week.
Priya Nair: decision needed: patch reservations to match available hw or accept overcommit and plan hot-fallback to hosted tier. leaning to patching reservations.
Alex Chen: if we patch, we need approvals from finance — created PR for reservation delta: https://git.redwood/infra/resv-prs/401
Samira Patel: code review pinged @Kaya for canary routing change — tiny flag in routing.yml
Kaya Liu: on it, will review in next hour
deploy-bot: Reservation R-2026-0456 marked 'pending' -> 'adjust_request' by Alex Chen :gear:
Jorge Ortega: procurement note — can reallocate 8 GPUs from internal research pool if we get approval; that buys 3 days of runway.
Priya Nair: can the research team accept temporary swap? @Samira can you confirm implications for their experiments?
Samira Patel: their long jobs are scheduled after 2026-05-10, so yes we can take 8 for the ramp window with notice.
Alex Chen: opened warroom channel #dedicated-resv-warroom for live coordination if needed :phone:
Kaya Liu: quick checklist for patch path: 1) PR approval 2) finance ok 3) infra patch reservations 4) canary routing flip 5) smoke test
Priya Nair: timeline proposal — aim to finalize today (within 8 hours) or else shift canary to eu-east on Mon. Owners: Alex (resv), Nate (infra), Samira (canary), Jorge (procurement), Kaya (routing), Priya (final decision)
All: :thumbsup:
